pressure.title: Keeping solids in suspension
pressure.description: The agitator must give enough upward flow to keep coarse bauxite particles off the floor (the "just-suspended" speed, Zwietering correlation). Tanks are sized for hours of residence to buffer the mills from digestion and to start pre-desilication. Solids content is typically ~ 40–55 wt % (slurry density control).

foundation: Ring-wall or slab foundation designed for full liquid/slurry weight plus agitator dynamic loads; settlement monitoring for large tanks.
alignment: Tank plumb and level; agitator shaft vertical and concentric; check gearbox mounting.
piping: Nozzles sized for slurry velocity (avoid settling and erosion); flush connections; scaling-resistant design and descaling access.
Caustic service: suitable materials, gaskets and spray shields; eyewash/safety showers nearby.
commissioning: Water trials (agitator run with water, check vibration and power); then caustic/slurry; verify levels, interlocks and spillage containment (bunds).

lubrication: Agitator gearbox oil and motor bearings per maker; no lubrication for static parts.

video_tutorials.title: Bauxite Slurry Mixing Tank — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Bauxite Slurry Mixing Tank.
A bauxite slurry mixing tank receives ground bauxite slurry and spent liquor and keeps the solids suspended with an agitator.
It buffers flow between grinding and digestion and is where slurry density is adjusted.

Typical applications include slurry storage and density control before desilication/digestion; buffering between grinding and digestion; mixing ground bauxite with spent liquor (liquor-to-solids ratio).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Slurry Tank: Agitator Shaft & Impeller, Slurry Transfer Pump (to digestion), Slurry Transfer Pump (to digestion) — Shaft & Coupling (turning).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Bauxite Slurry Mixing Tank.
Check agitator, level, density.
Inspect impeller wear and scale.
Gearbox overhaul.
Watch for solids settling: sanding, high torque at restart. Common cause: agitator stop, low speed.
Watch for scaling: reduced volume. Common cause: dsp scale.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
